title: How a Wanderlane Traveller Club Standing Bears on the Reissue Fee Taken Off a Release
content:
The reissue fee of the fare brand that produced an Air Ticket Fare Brands credit may be taken off in part, or not at all, according to the traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club. Two readings decide it: the value at which the club tier redeems points, in cents per point, and the qualifying points the membership's ledger records over the last 12 months.

## 1. What is taken off

1.1 Where the traveller's club tier redeems points at 1.3 cents or more per point and the membership has counted 60000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, no reissue fee is taken off: the deduction stands at 0.00 USD.

1.2 Where the tier redeems points at 1.0 cent or more per point and the membership has counted 30000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, while either that tier redeems points at less than 1.3 cents or those points are fewer than 60000, 0.5 of the reissue fee of the fare brand that produced the credit — 50 percent of it — is taken off.

1.3 In every other case no such treatment applies to the reissue fee.

## 2. What the points count is read from

The qualifying points behind that reading are the ones the membership's ledger records inside the period, not the standing total the membership record displays.

## 3. The two readings set side by side

| Redemption value of the tier | Qualifying points over the last 12 months | Reissue fee taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.3 cents or more per point | 60000 or more | 0.00 USD |
| 1.3 cents or more per point | 30000 or more but fewer than 60000 | 50 percent of the brand's reissue fee |
| 1.0 cent or more but less than 1.3 cents | 30000 or more | 50 percent of the brand's reissue fee |
| 1.0 cent or more | fewer than 30000 | no such treatment |
| less than 1.0 cent per point | any | no such treatment |

## 4. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

A booking held in a brand whose reissue fee is a hypothetical 75.00 USD, on a membership whose tier redeems points at 1.5 cents and whose ledger records 66000 qualifying points inside the window: nothing is taken off for the reissue fee.

The same booking on a membership whose tier redeems points at 1.5 cents but whose ledger records 38000 qualifying points: the first condition fails on the points, the second holds, and 37.50 USD is taken off.

The same booking on a membership whose tier redeems points at 0.8 cents: neither condition holds, and no such treatment applies.
